subject: oracle-gate: 8.5 GB is 13 git worktrees, and 5.2 GB more was hiding inside the repo

what_it_is.tell: .git is a 103-byte gitdir pointer, not a directory; identical 667 MB sizes across unrelated task IDs

second_finding.what: 6 more worktrees at a LITERAL "$HOME" path INSIDE the source repo
second_finding.cause: a script quoted $HOME so it never expanded — git created the directory literally
second_finding.why_it_matters: I was auditing ~/oracle-gate and would never have found this; it is 5.2 GB nobody is counting

redundancy_proven.method: git cat-file -t in the source repo — not inferred from equal sizes

what_was_actually_unique.verified: TASK-0710 tarball extracted and diffed file-by-file vs originals — 4/4 IDENTICAL

why_i_did_not_reclaim: review-batch alone holds 572 uncommitted changes including 141 untracked files. A size-based sweep would have destroyed real unpushed work with tests. It is another repo I do not own, so removal is Shaan's call — but the irreplaceable part is now safe either way.
